issues.title: Sync endpoint for the offline edit queue
issues.body:
`POST /v1/sync` for the offline edit queue: idempotency keys, cursor, per-session revision conflicts, tombstones. The server processes as many operations as fit its per-request query budget (50 D1 queries on Workers Free) and the client resends the rest.

Old needs: 2.5 (done).

issues.body:

Old needs: 2.6, 4.1 (done).

issues.title: Weekly review summary API
issues.body:
Weekly review summary API: planned vs completed, distance and time against plan, key sessions, check-in feel and pain, inbox loose ends (§6.6a); computed on the backend so the web sees it too. The computation is done (`api/src/domain/insights.ts`, `computeWeeklyReview`).

Old needs: 2.12, 2.17 (done).

issues.title: Proposals API: generate, accept, dismiss
issues.body:
Proposals API: generate, accept, dismiss; stale when the plan revision moves; re-running the interview regenerates future weeks only (property test: keeps past and user-owned sessions) and is delivered as a proposal. A pain flag in a check-in triggers an urgent proposal when the review setting is Weekly plus urgent (left from 2.12).

Old needs: 2.12, 2.13 (done).

issues.title: Distance done and "On track" on the plan screens
issues.body:
Distance done and "On track" on the plan screens, left from 3.5: Next's "5.1 of 25 km" and its progress bar, Week's "5.1 km done · plus 45 min cross-training", Whole's "15.2 / 16 km" per week and the goal card's "On track" badge. Today they show planned distance and sessions done.

Old needs: 2.15.

issues.title: Spec clarification for PATCH /v1/profile and check-in conflicts
issues.body:
Own PR (human merge; found by the 2.17 review): say that `heartRate`, `scheduling` and `review` replace their whole section (the only way to clear a field), and decide whether ranges may be equal and sub-objects reject unknown keys, as the API does today. Also give `POST /v1/sessions/{id}/checkins` a 409 for an id reused with another body (as plan create has; the API answers 400 `id_in_use` until then), and say in the schema that `effortFelt` is for after-session check-ins only.

Old needs: 2.17 (done).

issues.title: Goal and settings screen
issues.body:
Goal and settings: goal, re-run interview, review frequency and day, target display, account, privacy, data export. There is no DK board for it, so the plan proposes a layout from the existing tokens (no longer `ask first`: on 2026-10-30 the human agreed in a session to go ahead with that layout).

Old needs: 3.4 (done), 2.17 (done), 2.14, 2.16.

issues.title: Prune expired rows
issues.body:
Prune expired rows: `email_codes`, `rate_limits` windows and expired or rotated `refresh_tokens` (a scheduled Worker or on write), found by the 2.4 review.

Old needs: 2.4 (done).

issues.title: Dynamic Type on the interview and preview screens
issues.body:
Dynamic Type: the interview and preview screens use fixed system font sizes (`.font(.system(size:))`), which do not scale (docs/design-notes.md asks for `Font.custom(_, size:, relativeTo:)`). Bundle the fonts, scale every size, let rows wrap instead of clipping, and re-run the snapshot tests at a large size.

Old needs: 3.3 (done).
